sn38.6:1.2: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso sāriputta, paramassāsappatto hotīti.
sn38.6:1.3: yato kho āvuso bhikkhu channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimutto hoti, ettāvatā kho āvuso paramassāsappatto hotīti.
sn38.6:1.4: atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn38.6:1.5: atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn38.6:1.6: katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn38.6:1.7: ayameva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāya. seyyathidaṃ:
sn38.6:1.9: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn38.6:1.10: bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāya.
